Trails.Name: Lost in the Woods (Lower) Uphill Route
Lost in the Woods (Upper) Uphill Route

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Sunday, April 12, 2026 10:25 AM – Winter isn’t over yet, with 12–18" of fresh overnight snowfall. Low clouds are covering the upper mountain today, with further accumulation expected through tomorrow morning. Strong, gusty winds will increase through the day. 10 lifts are currently spinning, conditions permitting. See below for a detailed breakdown of expectations. Weather holds are likely for low visibility, strong winds, and mitigation work. While fresh snow may look inviting, hazards like dirt, rocks, and bushes remain just below the surface. Ski and ride with caution and avoid venturing off trail. 
 
Conditions and Visibility: A low-hanging cloud is hovering over much of the mountain today, creating low visibility conditions. Winds are currently gusting over 50 MPH around the mountain, and are forecasted to increase through the day. Temps are cold, with wind chills at Main Lodge of 5 degrees Fahrenheit.  
Lift status: 12 lifts are scheduled to spin today, conditions permitting.  
 
Lifts currently spinning: Broadway Express (1), Stump Alley Express (2), Face Lift Express (3), Roller Coaster Express (4), Unbound Express (6), Gold Rush Express (10), Discovery Express (11), Canyon Express (16), the Lower Panorama Gondola, and the Village Gondola, wind and weather permitting. 

High Five Express (5) and Chair 12 are delayed for mitigation.  
 
Chairs 13, 14, 23, and the Upper Panorama Gondola are on weather holds and are not anticipated to open today.  
 
Please note, Chair 7, Chair 8, Cloud Nine Express (9), Eagle Express (15), Schoolyard Express (17), Chair 20, Chair 21, Chair 22, and Chair 25 have wrapped up operations for the season. Canyon Lodge is open for access only through April 19, and Eagle Lodge is now closed for the season. Beginners should plan to ski out of Main Lodge for the best experience. 
Winter Activity status: Woolly’s Adventure Summit is open through today, April 12, with the Mountain Coaster, Snow Tubing, Rock Wall, and Woolly’s Mining all operating, weather permitting. Sno-Go Ski Bike Tours are available Sunday-Thursday. Tamarack Cross-Country Ski Center and Snowmobile Adventures are closed for the season. 
Safety: Spring obstacles exist beneath new snowfall. Please ski and ride with caution. Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is: 760.934.0611 
Road Conditions: Roads are covered in snow and ice, so please drive with caution. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest status.
